$comment: Maintained by hand. Unlike the vendored vocabularies beside it, this file has no upstream: scripts/vendor_reference_data.py never writes it. Edit it directly and the change is a reviewable diff rather than a code change. Values that circulate in metadata templates and get left behind. A placeholder is worse than a missing field: it asserts an identifier that does not exist, and registries harvest it.
